item.title: Fayette County man indicted on sexual assault and kidnapping charges in Kanawha County
item.description: A Fayette County man has been indicted on sexual assault and kidnapping charges in Kanawha County. According to Charleston Police, on Thursday, March 5, a grand jury granted an indictment against 44 year old Brian Steven Parker from Deep Water, WV. #FayetteCounty #KanawhaCounty #WOAY

item.title: State Fair of West Virginia announces Alabama based country band Shenandoah will perform 2026 concert series
item.description: The State Fair of West Virginia has another concert series announcement that classic country music lovers won't want to miss. Alabama-based band Shenandoah will rock the fair stage on Tuesday, August 18, with country favorites like “Two Dozen Roses,” “Next to You, Next to Me,” and “Church on Cumberland Road.” #GreenbrierCounty #WOAY

item.title: City of Fayetteville begins Phase I of Town Park playground makeover featuring accessible equipment for all to enjoy
item.description: The city of Fayetteville is creating room for accessible playground equipment to ensure every child has a place to play! The move is a part of Phase I of the city's playground makeover. #FayetteCounty #WOAY
